name: Guild calendar
description: A calendar for the guild's own events, shared with every member.
long_description:
Adds a calendar that belongs to the guild rather than to any initiative — for the events the whole guild shows up to.

It is an ordinary calendar: the same views, the same event editor, the same sharing. Everyone can see it to begin with; change who may add events by editing its sharing, the way you would for any calendar. Removing the app moves the calendar to the trash rather than deleting it outright.
